title: Core Octet #49
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, eight women in a single row.

A photograph of EIGHT women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 8 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Pose: mid-stride walking toward camera. Shoes: extreme cobalt-and-coral extreme platform thigh-skimming boots.

Lighting: the hard raking light carving every fold and curve on all 8, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 16:9 landscape 8K.
